newsitem.title: USA: RMI adjusts surcharge for volatility.
newsitem.headline: RMI adjusts surcharge for volatility.

text.p: RMI Titanium Co said on Friday it has informed customers that its metallics surcharge will be adjusted for orders on products shipping after January 31, 1997.

RMI said it attributes the surcharge adjustment that will average one through six percent to price volatility and spot availability of certain key raw material components that have led to uncertainties compounded by extended lead times.
RMI said the surcharge incorporates changes in scrap and prime raw material element costs.
Prices are subject to change and will be updated as necessary, RMI said.
RMI said it will continue to monitor this situation with its goal to reduce or eliminate the surcharge as conditions permit.
